blocks.source: assert rows_on(q, **{'employees': "SELECT CAST(emp_id AS INT) AS emp_id, CAST(name AS STRING) AS name, CAST(dept AS STRING) AS dept, CAST(manager_id AS INT) AS manager_id, CAST(salary AS INT) AS salary, CAST(hire_date AS DATE) AS hire_date FROM VALUES (1, 'a', NULL, NULL, 1, DATE'2020-01-01'), (2, 'b', NULL, NULL, 1, DATE'2020-01-01') AS employees(emp_id, name, dept, manager_id, salary, hire_date)"}) == [(2, 0, 0)], 'all null depts'

assert rows_on(q, **{'employees': 'SELECT * FROM (SELECT CAST(NULL AS INT) AS emp_id, CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS name, CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS dept, CAST(NULL AS INT) AS manager_id, CAST(NULL AS INT) AS salary, CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS hire_date) WHERE FALSE'}) == [(0, 0, 0)], 'empty table'

assert rows_on(q, **{'orders': "SELECT CAST(order_id AS INT) AS order_id, CAST(customer_id AS INT) AS customer_id, CAST(status AS STRING) AS status, CAST(order_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS order_ts, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount FROM VALUES (1, 1, 'paid', TIMESTAMP'2026-01-01 00:00:00', 5), (2, NULL, 'paid', TIMESTAMP'2026-01-01 00:00:00', 5) AS orders(order_id, customer_id, status, order_ts, amount)", 'customers': "SELECT CAST(customer_id AS INT) AS customer_id, CAST(name AS STRING) AS name, CAST(region AS STRING) AS region, CAST(signup_date AS DATE) AS signup_date FROM VALUES (1, 'a', 'N', DATE'2024-01-01'), (2, 'b', 'N', DATE'2024-01-01') AS customers(customer_id, name, region, signup_date)"}) == [(2, 'b')], 'null customer_id in orders'

assert rows_on(q, **{'orders': "SELECT CAST(order_id AS INT) AS order_id, CAST(customer_id AS INT) AS customer_id, CAST(status AS STRING) AS status, CAST(order_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS order_ts, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount FROM VALUES (1, 1, 'p', TIMESTAMP'2026-01-01 00:00:00', 99.99), (2, 1, 'p', TIMESTAMP'2026-01-01 00:00:00', 100), (3, 1, 'p', TIMESTAMP'2026-01-01 00:00:00', 500) AS orders(order_id, customer_id, status, order_ts, amount)"}) == [(1, '99.99', 'small'), (2, '100.00', 'medium'), (3, '500.00', 'large')], 'boundaries'
assert rows_on(q, **{'scores': "SELECT * FROM VALUES ('a', CAST(NULL AS INT)) AS scores(student, score)"}) == [(0, 1, None, 0.0)], 'all null'
